profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I use Arch on my M1 Macbook.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributing to our Chef to Ansible migration by writing playbooks to work with our internal APIs
• Working with Jenkins to create new pipelines for integration and deployment.
• Utilizing Docker and Kubernetes for application deployment and management,

positions.title: Core OS Transports QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Writing and maintaining Python tests for USB/Thunderbolt firmware pre-submission validation.
• Investigate and triage emerging issues to discover root cause and regression status.
• Update shell scripts with new functionality to help test issues, utilize protocol analyzers.
• Deployed internal system utilizing RFID tracking on lab equipment and new hardware.

positions.title: Lab QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintaining and expanding lab devices for software test.
• Writing and maintaining Python scripts.
• Configuring networking in the lab.
• Communicating with QA teams to triage and fix issues in testing.
• Developed a prototype tool in Swift that utilizes cURL, SSH, and SwiftUI to manage internal
databases and provide additional functionality in an efficient and user friendly manner.
• Tool was significantly faster than current systems with additional functionality.

volunteerExperiences.description: 501c3 non-profit specializing in vehicle recovery and back-country SAR.
